REQUIREMENT-SILENCE.hypothesis: A blank cell in a requirement column is read as MANDATORY. A holdout variant with deliberately blank requirement cells discriminates honest (UNKNOWN + warning) from fabricated (MANDATORY) handling.

BOOLEAN-SILENCE.hypothesis: Source-silent boolean cells collapse to a canonical false (or true for admitted) at two layers (deterministic mapper, stage-7 enum fold). Same discriminating holdout variant as above.

CATEGORY-SILENCE.hypothesis: Blank form category collapses to ENDORSEMENT with exact:true. Holdout variant: form rows with blank category cells.

TRANSPORT-HYGIENE.hypothesis: non-format residual; not a generalization cluster

dispositionRule: The three *-SILENCE clusters are candidate GENERALIZATION items ONLY if the G2/G3 no-edit holdout baseline shows them red on a never-seen variant; fixes then ride the standard loop (red fixture, minimal right-layer fix, hostile judge, offline gate, lockstep goldens where field values change). Residual clusters are recorded, not fixed, in this workstream.
